critical_errors.note: no training; generation errors are captured per id in the harness report

decoding.repair: none: the assistant turn is kept verbatim (only the <|im_end|> stop token and surrounding whitespace are removed); no SQL repair, no fence stripping

shard_size.definition: cases in the shard file; denominator of EX/all

predictions_present.definition: ids in the shard that the predictions file covers (after id normalisation)

predictions_missing.definition: ids in the shard with no prediction; they stay in EX/all and count as wrong

gold_executed.definition: gold queries that executed on the live server; denominator of EX/gold-executable

gold_unexecutable.definition: gold queries that failed to execute; removed from the EX denominator, kept in EX/all

ex_denominator.definition: EX/gold-executable denominator (== gold_executed); a prediction that is missing or fails to run scores 0 here

prediction_executed.definition: predictions that executed, among gold-executable cases

prediction_unexecutable.definition: predictions that were attempted and failed to execute, among gold-executable cases; counted as wrong

prediction_missing_among_gold_executable.definition: gold-executable cases with no prediction at all (missing from the predictions file)

not_executed.definition: cases whose execution was skipped (offline replay without a cache entry); never counted as gold-executable

notes: PostgreSQL gold is executed verbatim: no sqlglot transpile, no repo_rewrite, no regex. The old OOD report re-transpiled this gold with the SQLite rewrite; this harness measures what that rewrite would change instead of assuming it (see the rewrite audit and the frozen-ledger check).
Question ids are normalised by numeric suffix (ood:disney:0000 == ood:disney:0) so a run recorded with padded ids still pairs.

A usable OOD number must come from a model trained on the clean split (t14 run B onwards) and must be scored with --contamination ood876=clean --split-manifest <manifest>; the manifest hash is then printed in the report. Pre-dedupe-fix runs are labelled contaminated_run, not a result.
